summary: Implemented T102: model-backed strategy evaluation through the T061 event-driven engine. Added (1) a new T068-registered strategy identity `t102.model_backed.v1` with an 8-parameter schema declaring every tunable parameter; (2) a strategy-layer wrapper `ModelBackedStrategy` (with `ModelBackedEvaluationParameters`) under `robinhood_lp.strategy.model_backed` so the registry factory can build a validated wrapper without dragging the research package into the strategy layer's import graph; (3) model-backed T060 `RegimeModel` and `FeeOpportunityModel` components that satisfy the T060 contracts (RegimeAssessment/FeeOpportunityAssessment, no input mutation, ASSESSED/UNCERTAIN outcomes), consume a registered `ModelArtifactHandle`, and yield `UNCERTAIN` (with no position emitted) on missing/stale/unversioned/out-of-distribution artifacts or constant predictors; (4) a deterministic OOD gate (`evaluate_out_of_distribution`) covering artifact presence, version, staleness, training-pool-set membership and constant-prediction detection; (5) the `ValidatedManifestBinding` record that resolves the run's registered identity, parameter-schema version + checksum, registry version + checksum and code provenance against the T068 registry; (6) the `RobustnessEvidenceStatus` gate (CURRENT / LEGACY_ONLY / MISSING / REVISION_MISMATCH) that consumes the T106 schema-bound surface or a T064 legacy `ParameterSurface`, with `LegacyRobustnessFixture` as the read-only byte-identical migration fixture; (7) the `walk_forward_evaluate_model` orchestrator that consumes point-in-time, machine-recorded folds (`WalkForwardFold`), runs rule and model runners per fold, computes episode-level bootstrap confidence intervals (`compute_episode_bootstrap_intervals`), regime-conditional breakdowns (`compute_regime_conditional_breakdown`) and the explicit `RejectionRecord` when the verdict rejects a model that improves prediction but worsens LP economics (`build_rejection_record`); (8) the `ModelEvaluationReport` value object that names the binding identity, version and checksum, records bootstrap intervals and regime breakdowns, and carries the `RobustnessEvidenceCheck` verdict. The implementation (a) refuses an unregistered identity or a run request that does not name a registered identity (`UnregisteredEvaluationIdentityError`), (b) refuses an undeclared parameter, an out-of-range value, a wrong-type or wrong-unit axis, and a schema revision that disagrees with the evaluated run's binding (`SchemaBindingError`), (c) yields `UNCERTAIN` / `NO_TRADE` and blocks publication when T106 robustness evidence is missing, legacy-only, or revision-mismatched, never falling back to the unrestricted T064 surface, an inferred or default identity, or an unqualified baseline, (d) preserves the legacy T064 robustness artifact byte-identical and labelled legacy, (e) builds schema-bound surfaces deterministically per the validated T105 manifest's binding identity, (f) changes no ledger, risk, execution, or audit contract, and (g) grants no `HOLD`/`LP`/`AUTO_SWAP` authority. Layer purity: 738 targeted tests pass; ruff and the import-graph check both report no findings; the registry now enumerates 7 identities (5 T062 baselines + T065 adaptive-range + T102 model-backed) with the new identity in the closed T068 vocabulary.

residual_risks: The model-backed regime/fee-opportunity components convert a continuous predictor output to a closed regime-state sentinel and to a Q64.64 fee-edge integer via heuristic maps (`_prediction_to_regime_state`, `_prediction_to_fee_edge_q64_64`); production runs that consume real T101 model artifacts must verify the mapping against their target label distribution before publication.

The schema's `model_artifact_id` default is the literal sentinel `RULE_FALLBACK` (the registry rejects empty strings for `ParameterType.STR`); a registration that uses a different sentinel must add the sentinel to the OOD gate's unversioned / missing-handle path.

The walk-forward evaluator accepts `EpisodeRunner` callables; production code must inject the orchestrator's runner (built on the T061 event-driven engine and the T070 central risk gate) and must not pass evaluation inputs that fabricate episodes from non-engine sources.
Two unrelated pre-existing test failures (`test_abi_artifacts.py`, `test_documentation_citations.py`) are environment-only (forge setup, ARCHITECTURE.md reference) and unrelated to T102.
